svg.aria-label: AI-Powered SAS to Python Migration. Matched SAS output for 4,566 hospitals within 1 x 10 to the minus 12. Abt Global, fall 2026, client partnership. Star Ratings Studio on GitHub. Business problem: Agencies such as CMS run critical analytics on SAS, which carries high licensing costs and a shrinking talent pool. Manual migration is slow, error-prone, and risks losing institutional knowledge. Solution: An LLM-assisted workflow that translates SAS to Python, verifies output parity, and documents the business logic, evaluated on the CMS Hospital Star Ratings pipeline. My contributions: Translated and validated Program 1 across 4,566 hospitals within 1 x 10 to the minus 12 of SAS, built the end-to-end pipeline runner, and designed and developed the Star Ratings Studio web application. Built with Python, pandas, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, pytest, Docker, GitHub Actions.

g.text: Matched SAS output for 4,566 hospitals within 10−12.

svg.aria-label: SAS to Python. Two routes, SAS and Python, climb Atlanta terrain to the same summit inside a rangefinder ring. 4,566 hospitals, within one times ten to the minus twelve of SAS. Same summit, both routes.
